terbaru.judul: Lessons Learned from Virtual Transitions of Undergraduate Student Support Programs due to the COVID-19 Pandemic
terbaru.pelajaran: The COVID-19 global pandemic spurred sudden and dramatic changes in the way universities and research programs operate, often with negative consequences that have disproportionately affected minorities, women, and people with low income.

terbaru.judul: The Tierras Observatory: An ultra-precise photometer to characterize nearby terrestrial exoplanets
terbaru.pelajaran: We report on the status of the Tierras Observatory, a refurbished 1.3-m ultra-precise fully-automated photometer located at the F.

terbaru.judul: Numerical scheme for simulation of transient flows of non-Newtonian fluids characterised by a non-monotone relation between the symmetric part of the velocity gradient and the Cauchy stress tensor
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a numerical scheme for simulation of transient flows of incompressible non-Newtonian fluids characterised by a non-monotone relation between the symmetric part of the velocity gradient (shear rate) and the Cauchy stress tensor (shear stress).

terbaru.judul: Energy-stable linear schemes for polymer-solvent phase field models
terbaru.pelajaran: We present new linear energy-stable numerical schemes for numerical simulation of complex polymer-solvent mixtures.

terbaru.judul: Origin of life in a digital microcosm
terbaru.pelajaran: While all organisms on Earth descend from a common ancestor, there is no consensus on whether the origin of this ancestral self-replicator was a one-off event or whether it was only the final survivor of multiple origins.
